note: Established the premise from the record rather than the mandate: three consecutive adversarial passes on scripts/pro/pro-git-pull.sh (#5492 refuter, #5496 gate) each found a shape nobody asked about, and each cure was wrong about a neighbouring one. Read both PRs' real diffs and the resolver's actual branches before writing a line. Conclusion: the surface is under-specified, so the builder contract's depth-1 rule prescribes a spec, not a third patch.

Enumerator + reviewed baseline + spec. 102 constructible cells of 8 states x 7 actions x 2 policies = 112; 7 measured fields per cell; the 8th column (verdict) is human-written and the comparison never touches it, so the machine cannot overwrite the judgement.

matrix-refuter, fresh context, grading a diff it did not author. Found the instrument CONTENT-BLIND: the ls-tree probes asserted an object's silhouette (presence/type) and not its identity, so a fixture built with wrong content satisfied the assertion. Three faces of one defect.

One cure for all three faces rather than three patches: assert mode+type+blob SHA against hashes derived from the fixture constants via git hash-object, plus a recursive blob count under the path. Slice replacement initially DUPLICATED 76 lines and `bash -n` passed it -- caught only because all 5 sabotages then reported CAUGHT on the SAME cell. Restored and redone scoped to the function.

fix-verifier, independent, on fresh context: constructed a genuine engineered collision -- a REGULAR FILE whose bytes are exactly the symlink target string -- and confirmed the SHA assertion catches it where the silhouette assertion could not. Innocence run green at 102/102.

fs-scope-refuter: the CI red was not a flake. The rename_case_only axis measures a defect that exists ONLY where the filesystem folds case, and ubuntu is case-sensitive -- the cells still ran but measured a different phenomenon. Also proved macos-latest was already available in-repo, closing the coverage gap I had deferred.

Filesystem promoted from assumption to declared COORDINATE: three-outcome probe (folds / does not fold / unprobeable-FATAL-exit-3), axis held out with the held-out count printed inline, --write-baseline REFUSES from a partial run. Proved on a real case-folding volume AND a real case-sensitive one. macOS leg added with a gate that exit 1s if the runner does not fold case, so a green run there cannot mean 88 cells measured quietly.

verdict-auditor -- the first grading of the HUMAN half of this instrument. Found TWO FALSE `OK` verdicts (resolver crash is not fail-safe), two over-harsh KNOWN_BADs, and reasons misattributed on four more rows. None of it visible to the machine: the 7 measured fields were correct throughout and never moved.

Verdicts corrected (50 OK / 52 KNOWN_BAD, from 54/48) and the guard extended to the OPTIMISTIC side: an unargued KNOWN_BAD is merely pessimistic, an unargued OK is a defect blessed in writing. The guard now demands a reason wherever OK is a CLAIM rather than an observation.

I REFUTED A CORRECT FINDING WITH A PROBE OF THE WRONG SHAPE. `cp -p` onto a dangling symlink exits 1 when the target has a missing intermediate directory, and exits 0 while FOLLOWING the link when the target is a bare filename with an existing parent. I probed the first; the fixture commits the second. The wrong mechanism reached the baseline, the doc and a report to the owner before being corrected in all three. Recorded because the report was already sent.

cell-reproducer, 22 cells reproduced individually. The reason text on 28 rows named a mechanism that does not fire, in two OPPOSITE ways: on 16 non-rename rows of dangling_symlink/dir_at_path the tracked branch RUNS and crashes inside cp -p (signature: backup dir created and EMPTY); on the 12 rename rows the resolver never runs at all. A cure aimed at the reason as written would have landed in two empty places.

Authoring this pack, re-derived the axis arithmetic from the baseline instead of from the document and found the document wrong: the A axis listed seven local states and omitted `symlink`, which has a 12-cell row in its own register table, and the totals said 88 of 98 where the truth is 102 of 112. The stale 88 was the dangerous half -- it is ALSO the case-sensitive measured count, so the document carried two unrelated 88s. Fixed in 644a9fe0d2.

Cross-family, effort high, read-only, on the real diff. FOUR findings with file:line. (1) THE CASE-ONLY keeplocal FIXTURE DOES NOT CONSTRUCT keeplocal: the allowlist is written with the ORIGINAL spelling (spec_collision_matrix.sh:309 writes "$P" = Subject.md) while the incoming path is subject.md, and the resolver matches with `grep -qxF` (pro-git-pull.sh:199) which is whole-line and byte-literal — so all 7 rename_case_only keeplocal cells exercise the ORDINARY policy under a keeplocal label. VERIFIED by the conductor at both named lines. (2) The enumerator cannot observe the symlink defect it registers: backup classification collapses regular files and preserved symlinks into backup=file, so curing `cp -p` to preserve the link would move NO measured field and the comparator would still print MATRIX STABLE. (3) Final-state measurement is lossy on the flagship axis: exact directory-entry spelling makes a live lowercase subject.md read `absent` on a folding volume, and regular files are sampled on only 14 bytes, so wrong content past byte 14 passes. (4) The macOS job is allocated unconditionally — step-level `if:` can skip the matrix but cannot stop a 10x-billed runner from starting. Finding 4 was reached INDEPENDENTLY by the Gear-3 gate.

Two attempts, full prompt and reduced: HTTP 200 both times with content length 0 and reasoning length 0. An empty answer is not a clean one — not counted as a review seat. The seat is LIVE (it answers a trivial probe correctly); it did not render a judgement on this diff.
